declaredIdentity: TechnologyInventoryStreams.Address(tenant,id) physically shared with InformationAsset/DataFlow; foreign-event sentinels reject other kinds and shared append OCC serializes competing creates. Cloud account id=systemInstanceId; other creation id=RequestId. Create compares current content instead of original; Revise expectedRevision lacks exact retry recognition.
invariant: One tenant inventory identity has exactly one record kind; a component keeps immutable category/system-instance binding, cloud account keyed to its unique instance, and category-specific valid content/lifecycle.
boundaryRationale: Splitting class-specific record streams by type would lose shared identity-kind exclusion. Component mutable values/category restrictions belong one governed component lifecycle; no parent component roster needed.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: caller-supplied immutable creation identity: an exact retry with the same id and authored intent returns the original result; the same id with changed intent is refused; a different id is a different record
CommandId binds one immutable authored intent to the exact owner identity and expected revision: an exact retry returns the original result, a changed intent under the same CommandId is refused

baselineIdentityObservation: TechnologyInventoryStreams.Address(tenant,id) physically shared with InformationAsset/DataFlow; foreign-event sentinels reject other kinds and shared append OCC serializes competing creates. Cloud account id=systemInstanceId; other creation id=RequestId. Create compares current content instead of original; Revise expectedRevision lacks exact retry recognition.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Tenant + caller ComponentId using preserved TechnologyInventoryStreams identity; cloud-account identity remains bound to its selected system instance.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant + caller ComponentId using preserved TechnologyInventoryStreams identity; cloud-account identity remains bound to its selected system instance.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.

productRules.rule: The technology inventory is recorded at account and environment granularity with component categories cloud_account, environment, network, data_store, repository, and endpoint_class, not per resource; each component has a governed name, owner, environment reference, location reference, and lifecycle.
A cloud_account infrastructure component corresponds one-to-one with a SystemInstance of kind cloud_account and must not be duplicated.
An endpoint class is a class record with a count and a management source; individual devices are not inventoried.

decides: Inventory is at account and environment granularity with categories cloud_account, environment, network, data_store, repository and endpoint_class, never per resource; each component carries a governed name, owner, environment reference, location reference and lifecycle. A cloud_account component shares its SystemInstance identity one-to-one, and an endpoint_class holds a count and management source, never individual devices.
